The instance is too slow (retried once and still timed out): RSSHub must fetch the source site on the first request and caches it afterwards, so trying again usually works
DNS lookup failed: the domain does not exist, or the current network cannot resolve it
Certificate validation failed: self-hosted instances often use self-signed or expired certificates that Android does not trust (browsers let you continue, apps do not) — use a trusted certificate
The connection was refused or interrupted — check your network or switch instances
The instance returned no valid content: the parameters may be wrong, or the route no longer works
Not a valid RSS/Atom feed, and no usable feeds were found
The instance returned 404: the parameters may be wrong, or this instance does not host the route
Instance rate-limited (429): public instances have limits — try again later or switch instances
Instance denied access (%1$s): common on public instances — consider self-hosting
Instance error %1$s: the instance itself is failing — try another
The request returned nothing — try again later
Custom instance %1$s is unreachable — check it in Me → RSSHub instance
All built-in instances are unreachable — check your network or add a self-hosted one
